caption: The video captures an under-surface view of a koi pond, where a pale cream-and-white fish fills the left foreground with its tail and rear body angled toward the center, while a red-and-white koi holds a head-up posture at the right edge. Several smaller orange and yellow fish drift through the dark green mid-ground, and bright rippling reflections shimmer across the top. A large, out-of-focus orange fish mass slides in from the upper left, slowly occluding the pale koi's body as it passes. The pale koi rotates and translates, bringing its white, red-spotted head into the upper left with its mouth opening. At the right, the red-and-white koi tilts its head further upward and widens its mouth, holding that open, surface-facing stance. The smaller fish continue shifting horizontally. The framing stays largely steady throughout.
relations: An out-of-focus orange mass sliding from the upper left progressively occludes the pale koi's rear body.
The pale koi rotates and translates, bringing its red-spotted head to the upper left while opening its mouth.
The red-and-white koi tilts its head upward and widens its mouth, maintaining a surface-facing posture.
Smaller orange and yellow fish in the dark mid-ground continue shifting horizontally beneath the rippling surface reflections.
